title: Conway Ginger Gin Buck
description: Dry gin, spicy ginger beer, and fresh lime over ice.
ingredients: ½ fluid ounce fresh lime juice
steps: Fill a tall glass with ice. Add the gin and lime juice.
Top with ginger beer and stir once gently. Garnish with one lime wedge.
imageAlt: Golden ginger beer highball with ice and a lime wedge
